caption: AI Agent Tool Use Information
description: The AI Agent Tool Use Information object provides detail pertaining to the AI Agent Activity: Tool Use event type.
name: ai_agent_tool_use_info

ai_tool_input.description: The arguments the AI agent passed to the tool. A serialized JSON string from the event source is deserialized exactly once, and JSON text inside the resulting string values is left as text. See the ai_tool_input dictionary attribute for the full rule.

ai_tool_response.description: The result the tool returned to the AI agent. A serialized JSON string from the event source is deserialized exactly once, and JSON text inside the resulting string values is left as text. See the ai_tool_response dictionary attribute for the full rule. Not populated when is_pre_occurrence is true.

is_pre_occurrence.description: true indicates that the tool has not yet been invoked. false indicates that the tool use has occurred.

name.description: The name of the invoked tool as the agent runtime reports it, e.g. Bash, apply-patch, or an MCP tool name such as mcp__tickets__search.
